lead: A `rule:` citation wrapped across two comment lines fails `bun nv rules --check` from a file you never touched.
body: `docs/agent/goals/` had split `rule:ide/the-extension-refuses-a-binary-it-does-not-understand` over two `#` lines, so the checker read the first half as a rule id that does not exist and `bun nv rules --render` has exited 1 ever since — which lands on whoever next edits `docs/rules/`, because `bun nv session --wrap` runs both for them. Reword the sentence so the token sits on one line rather than breaking one across a wrap.
